name: read-docs
description: Read current official documentation, release notes and API references for libraries, frameworks, SDKs and APIs. Use before answering when the user names a version, is upgrading, pastes an error from a library or tool, or asks how to use, configure or migrate a specific library or API, even without an explicit request to look up docs. Model knowledge stops at a training cutoff and misses new releases, renamed APIs, changed defaults and recent fixes, so when a version, option, error or API is unfamiliar or may have changed, look it up instead of guessing. Prefer it over general web search for library documentation. Excludes general programming explanations and tasks fully answered by supplied code or documentation.
